PC: Obtain intravenous (IV) access, place on monitor, apply oxygen, and obtain vital signs
Collect adjuncts and difficult airway equipment (Naso-pharyngeal airway (NPA), oral-pharyngeal airway (OPA), stylet, bougie, scalpel/cricothyrotomy kit)
Attempt to pre-oxygenate with non-rebreather or nasal cannula at high flow rate
Suction out airway secretions
Provide bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilations
Achieve mask seal with minimal leak
Avoid compressing airway, lift face into mask
Provide measured administration of breaths (over 1 second)
Avoid hyper (>20 breaths/min) or hypo (<12 breaths/min) ventilation
Use adjuncts as necessary (NPA, OPA) to assist in pre-oxygenation
Assemble equipment, at minimum: BVM attached to O2, suction, laryngoscope (confirmed functional), endotracheal tube (size 7.0-8.0, confirmed intact balloon), stethoscope
Recognize and utilize an acceptable sedative at correct dose for RSI:Eg Etomidate, 0.2-0.4mg/kg IV, Ketamine, 1-2mg/kg IV, or Propofol 1-3mg/kg IV

Perform endotracheal intubation, and verbalize confirmation with multiple methods (eg direct visualization, fog in tube, absent epigastric sounds, bilateral chest rise, bilateral breath sounds) If difficulty, utilize bougie for placement of tube
Avoid dental trauma by minimizing contact with teeth and avoiding using teeth as fulcrum for laryngoscope tilting
Ensure (if cuffed tube) that cuff is inflated to appropriate level (5-10ml)
Ensure tube not displaced
Do not release ETT until securely fixed with tape or securement device
Secure at appropriate initial depth (e.g. ETT size x 3)
Discuss appropriate post-intubation care
Provide appropriate post-intubation sedationE.g. benzodiazepine or propofol drips, plus fentanyl drip
Obtain and interpret STAT post-procedural CXR to confirm tube position
Order arterial blood gas
MK: Verbalize failure to protect airway, and respiratory failure
Recognize need for backups for possible difficult intubation
ICS: Verbalize acuity, and recruit multiple healthcare workers to assist
Promptly lead team in successful intubation
